scope: Description-only clarification of the existing LSTM comparator; no retraining, calibration, threshold, prediction, metric, or timing changes
published_design: single-layer, 50 hidden units; implemented here in PyTorch with 500 inputs and a two-output linear readout

initialization.trainable_gate_bias: zero except forget gate initialized to one

optimizer: PyTorch Adam; initial learning rate 0.0005; cosine schedule after each update
loss: equally weighted event BCE and voltage MSE; voltage scaled by 0.1

actual_config.recipe: ICLR-2024 Appendix B / Table S10 LSTM-50. No public LSTM checkpoint provided; paper recipe, not a separately verified checkpoint replay.
adaptations: 500 fixed E/I input IDs instead of NeuronIO 1278 inputs; exact event multiplicity retained
Physical 400/500ms windows and 150/154ms overlaps retained; ELM delta_t adjusted; TCN kernels discretized to retain 152ms physical context
Corresponding DBNN fit/validation events; no main31 data in training, PCA or selection
Original output moment alignment replaced by one validation-fitted affine map, locked before held-out evaluation; raw results retained

numerical_probe.scope: Confirms current standardLSTM equations; does not establish author unpublished JAX initializer/gate implementation equivalence

model_class_source:
def __init__(self):
        super().__init__();self.recurrent=nn.LSTM(500,50,batch_first=True);self.output=nn.Linear(50,2)
        # Keras-style classic LSTM: one trainable bias, Glorot input / orthogonal
        # recurrent initialization, unit forget bias. This gives the paper's
        # 265902 trainable parameters with its original 1278 input channels.
        with torch.no_grad():
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.recurrent.weight_ih_l0);nn.init.orthogonal_(self.recurrent.weight_hh_l0)
            self.recurrent.bias_hh_l0.zero_();self.recurrent.bias_ih_l0.zero_();self.recurrent.bias_ih_l0[50:100]=1
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(self.output.weight);self.output.bias.zero_()
        self.recurrent.bias_hh_l0.requires_grad_(False)
    def forward(self,x):return self.output(self.recurrent(x)[0])
